reason: Both known-population-preserving exact-moment schemes failed fixed noise gates, including FD stress on missing PDFs. Follow the published all-population regularizedFD principle in an explicitly exterior auxiliary layer.
reference: Wissocq et al., arXiv1701.07734v1, sections2 reconstruction and3 stability. Their BGK/all-population results are method references only; no claim their stability transfers to D3Q27 cumulants.
physical_core: Preserve every original physical cell, dx/dt, viscosity, collision rates and initial-noise array. Add exactly one owned auxiliary cell on each nonperiodic x/y side; z remains periodic. Reconstruct all27 PDFs only in the new exterior layer. No source or PDF overwrite inside the original physical core.
time_storage: Use the standard collide-then-stream implementation so the stored PDFs are pre-collision, matching the paper's boundary reconstruction after streaming. Same cumulant collision and initialization at equilibrium. Require an independent periodic macro-phase equivalence test against the old stream-collide implementation before boundary tests.
forecast: Linearized isothermal characteristic system around the same Uinf, using own auxiliary rho/u. Incoming Rminus evolves with the same vortex correction on outflow; outgoing Rplus uses an inward one-point upwind normal derivative; tangential velocities use convective and pressure terms. SSPRK3 integrates this coupled surface system. Interior values are held at current time during its stages, an explicit first-order coupling approximation. Inflow Rminus/tangential velocity are reservoir values; exact-glancing Rminus is traced from its own initial field at stage times.
reconstruction: After ordinary collision/streaming, combine current-time core macros with predicted next-time exterior macros. Compute second-order centered/one-sided Cartesian velocity derivatives. Pre-collision stress uses tau_s=1/omega, tau_bulk=1 from unchanged collision; full factorized equilibrium plus the previously moment-verified covariance correction rebuilds all27 exterior PDFs. The next normal cumulant collision handles them; no BGK collision substitution.
budgets: Treat exterior overwrite as an explicit auxiliary mass/momentum exchange and record it. Original physical-core PDF overwrite must be exactly0; core total change must equal the incoming/outgoing population flux across its original box to2e-12 per cell. This retains the old physical-core conservation/ownership criterion; it does not disguise exterior sources as conservative interior collision.
noise: Same96x48x8 physical core, U=(.04,0,0), nu=.04*32/30000, seed3107,std1e-8 and exact initial SHA.10000 steps, sample100. Both core energy and combined core+auxiliary total energy divided by original core initial energy must stay<=1.1; no hidden growing auxiliary mode. Existing finite/rho/Ma guards apply to all cells.
next: If noise passes, unchanged physical acoustic/vortex/shear/radiation/glancing thresholds measured on the same physical core. Distances in the augmented coordinates must map back to original coordinates. No airfoil promotion before all these pass and then fixed N32 exits3c/6c to t*=12.
limits: No complete nonlinear viscous NSCBC or high-Re validation; corner and backflow handling remain hypotheses under test. Prototype NumPy boundary loops are not a CPU performance claim. Windows/GPU/offline release not_run unless a candidate becomes acceptable.
resources: Known2CPU/8GiB. Physical noise core adds about4% cells; two unchanged27-PDF buffers plus several4-macro arrays. No new dependency or installed-package modification. New binary fields remain local; text source/results/hashes only for publication.
